title: IFZModDialog
blurb: A BepInEx library that fires the game's native radio transmission modal with 1–4 player-choice buttons and routes each click to a C# callback.

reference.notes: Additive-only API. Do not version-pin the BepInDependency unless you require a specific minimum.

types.name: Plugin
types.summary: BepInEx plugin entry point for IFZModDialog. Exists so consumer mods can BepInDependency on it for load order, and to own the shared logger.

members.remarks: Used by consumers as the BepInDependency target.
Set in Awake; accessible for logging from this library.
Called by BepInEx; initializes the shared logger.

types.name: DialogOption
types.summary: One choice on a radio prompt: a button label and the C# callback run when the player picks it.

members.returns: string — the button text shown to the player
members.remarks: If null, defaults to "Option N" in localization injection.

members.returns: Action — the callback invoked when the player selects this option
members.remarks: Set via the constructor or property assignment.

params.name: label
params.desc: The button text shown to the player

params.name: onPick
params.desc: The callback invoked when the player selects this option

types.name: RadioPrompt
types.summary: Fire the game's native radio transmission modal with 1–4 player-choice buttons, and route each click to a C# callback. Uses the real transmission lifecycle (load → show → play → answer → close), so audio and UI teardown are handled by the game.

members.returns: int — maximum buttons the native panel supports (default/option2/option3/option4)
members.remarks: Options beyond this count are silently truncated.

members.signature: public static void Ask(string id, string promptText, DialogOption[] options, Action onUnavailable = null)

params.name: id
params.desc: A stable unique key per prompt TYPE (used as the transmission id, the localization namespace, and the xml filename — keep it constant across calls of the same prompt)

params.name: promptText
params.desc: The prompt text shown to the player

params.name: options
params.desc: 1–4 options. If more than 4, silently truncated to 4.

params.name: onUnavailable
params.desc: Optional callback run when the UI can't be driven (resolves fail), so game logic never stalls on UI.

members.remarks: Writes a loose transmission asset, injects localization, subscribes to DialogueManager, and starts the transmission. If any step fails, onUnavailable runs instead so game logic never stalls on UI.
